harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured and restart-validated `offline-rhel8`. Node1 serves a signed, dependency-complete RHEL 8.8 repository on TCP/8080. Node2 enforces metadata and RPM signatures, uses priority 10 versus priority 90 for other enabled repositories, and can reinstall zsh with all other repositories disabled.
actions_performed: Published 161 signed RPMs, including zsh and its complete dependency closure
Generated and published the repository public signing key
Enabled persistent Apache service and firewalld access on TCP/8080
Installed and repeatedly reinstalled zsh using only offline-rhel8
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and recovery

evidence.requirement: Repository content, dependencies, metadata, and public key
evidence.summary: Shows 161 RPMs including zsh, successful repository closure, published metadata/signature/key/package, and retained content after restart.
Proves a valid detached metadata signature, 161/161 valid RPM signatures, and successful DNF verification/import of the published key.

evidence.requirement: HTTP publication on node1 TCP port 8080
evidence.summary: Shows Apache listening on 8080, firewall access enabled, successful client HTTP retrieval, and post-restart service recovery.

evidence.requirement: Signature enforcement and repository priorities on node2
evidence.summary: Shows offline-rhel8 enabled with gpgcheck=1, repo_gpgcheck=1, priority 10, and BaseOS/AppStream at priority 90, retained after restart.

evidence.requirement: Install and keep zsh reinstallable with all other repositories disabled
evidence.summary: Shows installation from offline-rhel8, signed operational package state, and successful offline-only reinstalls before and after node2's restart.
Captures healthy baseline boot a1be807a-f931-4328-b608-cd61f894ed55, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot b755b67a-cf7e-4878-b223-83c6078b8fdd, and recovered service and repository data.

Captures healthy baseline boot 953e6cb5-ce48-44db-bc5a-32edac59aac5, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot 65d96c2f-27fa-480b-b83a-f9cff1ec5099, recovered package/policy/repository state, and a successful post-restart offline-only reinstall.
